corrections.displayTitle: Meta / Jio report · direct ownership interpretation held
corrections.summary: Outlook Business reported on 21 June 2026 that Meta affiliate Jaadhu Holdings held 9.98% in Jio Platforms. This is a secondary report; it does not establish a direct Meta Platforms, Inc. holding or current ownership. The retained Reliance-group endpoint is not a reviewed identity match to Jio Platforms.
corrections.sourceDateBasis: Displayed Outlook publication/update date only; no timezone or ownership onset inferred.
corrections.notice: Direct parent-brand ownership interpretation held from factual graphs and paths pending reviewed legal-vehicle and Jio endpoint matching. Original wording remains superseded audit material.
corrections.temporalLimitation: Historical CCI approval in 2020 does not verify the 2026 news cap table, payment, continuous ownership, or the unresolved 9.99% versus 9.98% difference.
